proved_scoped: exact affine-coset support bundles of width at most three can be recognized using constant-size local truth tables
their conjunction can be carried as a GF(2) linear system and existentially projected to the live boundary by Gaussian elimination
the R44AR parity-chain family that is exponentially large in equivalent auxiliary-free CNF projects to one GF(2) boundary row in the frozen typed message language

interpretation.positive: The known parity projection blow-up is representation-specific, not semantic: a richer exact typed affine carrier removes that exponential encoding debt on the frozen family.
interpretation.limitation: The carrier is not a general 3-CNF projector. Mixed/non-affine support bundles remain unresolved.
interpretation.next: Build a proof-carrying typed sum-of-languages open-message algebra and test exact interaction/composition between affine factors and non-affine CNF factors without branch-choice reification.
